scientific.integrity: The minimization argument is symbolic and independent of the finite checker. The published regular-Reuleaux area formula was materially inspected, and the full text of the closest Reuleaux asymmetry paper was checked for implication-level coverage.
limitations: No extremality claim is made among irregular Reuleaux polygons of fixed order.
The minimizing center is shown to be attainable at the dihedral center, but uniqueness of the minimizing center is not asserted.
Historical novelty retains a residual risk from unindexed classical notes or exercises.

title: Exact Estermann measure of regular Reuleaux polygons
